guarantees.claim: hw2reg.status.fifo_full.d is always equal to fifo_full.
hw2reg.status.fifo_empty.d is always equal to fifo_empty.
hw2reg.status.fifo_depth.d is always equal to fifo_depth.
hw2reg.status.hmac_idle.d is always equal to idle.

assumptions.claim: The status source signals (fifo_full, fifo_empty, fifo_depth, idle) are stable and meet setup/hold timing relative to the hw2reg register capture clock edge.
assumptions.risk: If these signals glitch or transition near the capture edge, hw2reg may latch an incorrect or metastable value, causing software to see wrong FIFO or idle status.

uncertain_points.claim: The internal generation of fifo_full, fifo_empty, fifo_depth, and idle is in other chunks; their correctness (e.g., full/empty logic matches FIFO threshold, depth is accurate, idle truly indicates pipeline quiescence) must be verified elsewhere.
uncertain_points.risk: If any of these signals are incorrectly computed elsewhere, the status registers will propagate wrong information, potentially leading to software flow-control errors.
